# GCF-1.1 Genesis Compiler Foundation v1.1

## Package Identity
- Project: Genesis Compiler Foundation v1.1
- Package: GCF-1.1
- Type: Constitutional Foundation Release
- Classification: Governance and Documentation Only
- Date: 2026-08-03

## Purpose
This package records the official constitutional closeout of Genesis Compiler Phase 1 and establishes the permanent runtime substrate baseline for future compiler phases.

## Scope
Included:
- Governance closeout record for GCI-P1-0001 through GCI-P1-0005
- Foundation architecture declaration and principles
- Frozen production baseline record
- Lifecycle closeout metadata
- Phase 2 roadmap sequencing record (governance only)

Excluded:
- Runtime implementation changes
- Test modifications
- Dependency, schema, CI, or compiler behavior changes
- Phase 2 authorization or execution

No Phase 2 implementation is authorized by this package. Separate governance authorization remains mandatory.
